question: Can a five-frame causal LiDAR network learn explicit robot-frame geometry, five structural events, place association and variable incident-exit geometry consistently across seeds 0/1/2 on the frozen 80/10 development split, before any strict-test or topology replay?
method: Train GeometrySemanticEventNet with a circular range-image encoder, causal five-frame GRU, event/axis/metric/place/uncertainty heads and six-query exit set attention. Every epoch visits each train sequence once in deterministic pair-aware batches; losses use explicit validity masks, fixed physical normalization, inverse-frequency event weights and identity-balanced supervised contrastive terms. Select each checkpoint by minimum unaugmented full-validation total loss only.
baseline: The no-update random initialization is evaluated through the identical full validation path (event macro-F1 0.166545) to prove metric sensitivity. Later scientific gates compare against the frozen Cano-like exit-only model and non-learning geometry estimator; this run performs no baseline tuning, threshold calibration or topology replay.

user_authorization.scope: Create and execute exactly one immutable Gate-2 training run containing seeds 0/1/2 over 188126 train and 24462 validation GSE sequences, with validation-only checkpoint selection and zero C10/M-TARE reads.

acceptance_criteria: The source dataset remains an immutable completed PASS and all 33083 source-seal entries verify before and after training. Exactly 188126 train and 24462 validation sequences are visible; C10 and M-TARE reads remain zero.

The formal no-update real batch contains 64 five-frame samples, at least one positive association identity, finite complete losses and backward gradients, unchanged weights, zero optimizer steps and no checkpoint.

Seeds 0, 1 and 2 each complete at most 30 full-coverage epochs with patience 6, finite losses/gradients/validation metrics, exactly one best and one last checkpoint, full validation outputs, and no missing or duplicated epoch samples.
Checkpoint selection uses only minimum total loss over all 24462 unaugmented validation sequences. No threshold calibration, test evaluation, graph replay or planner tuning occurs.

Each seed stays below 16 GiB host RSS, 28 GiB allocated GPU memory and 40000 seconds; aggregate output stays below 8 GiB and total wall time below 36 hours. Any failure stops and seals the one run without changing or retrying the contract.
